topic: Day 74 — reel — The smallest version done today beats the perfect version done someday
text:
The two-minute
version [today]
beats the perfect
one someday.
caption:
A habit survives on how cheap it is to start. The ambitious version keeps sliding to tomorrow; the small one is already done.

Follow for one of these a day.
